HOW TO IMPORT INTO ASEPRITE & SAVE AS .ASEPRITE
════════════════════════════════════════════════

Step 1 — Open a PNG
  File → Open → select any PNG from the /PNG folder
  (e.g. 01_cherry_blossom_tree_32x32.png)

Step 2 — Verify canvas size
  Make sure the canvas is 32x32 px.
  Go to Edit → Canvas Size if needed.

Step 3 — Load the color palette
  Window → Palettes → click "..." → Load Palette
  Select: feudal_japan_nature_palette.gpl

Step 4 — Save as Aseprite source file
  File → Save As → choose "Aseprite (*.aseprite)"
  Suggested name: feudal_japan_nature.aseprite

Step 5 — Re-export to PNG (optional)
  File → Export Sprite Sheet
  → Type: Packed / By Rows
  → Output: PNG

── TILEABLE ASSETS NOTE ─────────────────────────────────

  Three assets in this pack tile seamlessly:

  02_koi_pond_tile      — all directions
  04_bamboo_grove       — all directions
  07_mossy_stone_path   — all directions

  In Tiled / LDtk: stamp repeatedly as a ground layer.
  In RPG Maker: use as tileset layer (Autotile compatible
  with minor edge cleanup in Aseprite).
